library(dplyr)

# ===========================
# Step 1: Import Data
# ===========================

```{r}
data_path <- "C:/Users/dyuti/OneDrive/Desktop/readmission_project/data/FY_2025_Hospital_Readmissions_Reduction_Program_Hospital (1).csv"
hosp_data <- read.csv(data_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```


# ===========================
# Step 2: Data Cleaning & Transformation
# ===========================

```{r}
hosp_data <- hosp_data %>%
mutate(
Measure.Name = trimws(Measure.Name),
State = toupper(trimws(State)),
Excess.Readmission.Ratio = as.numeric(Excess.Readmission.Ratio),
Expected.Readmission.Rate = as.numeric(Expected.Readmission.Rate),
Number.of.Discharges = as.numeric(Number.of.Discharges),
Number.of.Readmissions = as.numeric(Number.of.Readmissions)
) %>%
filter(!is.na(Excess.Readmission.Ratio) & !is.na(Number.of.Discharges) & !is.na(Expected.Readmission.Rate))

head(hosp_data)

summary(hosp_data[,c("Excess.Readmission.Ratio","Number.of.Discharges","Expected.Readmission.Rate")])
```

# ===========================
# Step 3: Scatter Plot: Excess Readmission Ratio vs Number of Discharges
# ===========================

```{r}
ggplot(hosp_data, aes(x = Number.of.Discharges, y = Excess.Readmission.Ratio)) +
geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "blue") +
geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = TRUE) +
theme_minimal() +
labs(x = "Number of Discharges", y = "Excess Readmission Ratio",
title = "Excess Readmission Ratio vs Number of Discharges")
```

# ===========================
# Step 4: State-wise Average Excess Readmission Ratio
# ===========================

```{r}
state_summary <- hosp_data %>%
group_by(State) %>%
summarise(AvgExcessRatio = mean(Excess.Readmission.Ratio, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
rename(state = State) %>%
arrange(desc(AvgExcessRatio))

ggplot(state_summary, aes(x = reorder(state, AvgExcessRatio), y = AvgExcessRatio, fill = AvgExcessRatio)) +
geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
coord_flip() +
scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red") +
theme_minimal() +
labs(x = "State", y = "Average Excess Readmission Ratio",
title = "State-wise Average Excess Readmission Ratio")
```
# ===========================
# Step 5: Top & Bottom 10 Hospitals
# ===========================

```{r}
top10 <- hosp_data %>% arrange(desc(Excess.Readmission.Ratio)) %>% head(10)
bottom10 <- hosp_data %>% arrange(Excess.Readmission.Ratio) %>% head(10)

leaderboard <- rbind(
cbind(Rank = 1:10, Category = "Top 10", top10[,c("Facility.Name","State","Measure.Name","Excess.Readmission.Ratio")]),
cbind(Rank = 1:10, Category = "Bottom 10", bottom10[,c("Facility.Name","State","Measure.Name","Excess.Readmission.Ratio")])
)

kable(leaderboard, caption = "Top and Bottom 10 Hospitals by Excess Readmission Ratio") %>%
kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```
# ===========================
# Step 6: Condition-wise Analysis
# ===========================

```{r}
condition_summary <- hosp_data %>%
group_by(Measure.Name) %>%
summarise(
AvgExcessRatio = mean(Excess.Readmission.Ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
AvgNumberDischarges = mean(Number.of.Discharges, na.rm = TRUE)
) %>%
arrange(desc(AvgExcessRatio))

ggplot(condition_summary, aes(x = reorder(Measure.Name, AvgExcessRatio), y = AvgExcessRatio, fill = AvgExcessRatio)) +
geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
coord_flip() +
scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkred") +
theme_minimal() +
labs(x = "Condition", y = "Average Excess Readmission Ratio",
title = "Average Excess Readmission Ratio by Condition")

```

#US Map

```{r}
pdf("state_map.pdf", width=6, height=4)
plot_usmap(data = state_summary, values = "AvgExcessRatio") +
scale_fill_continuous(low = "white", high = "red", name = "Avg Excess Ratio") +
theme(legend.position = "right") +
ggtitle("State-wise Average Excess Readmission Ratio")
dev.off()

```
